LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.5: Descant Recorder
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Descant Recorder, part of Performing and Displaying in Grade 4 CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How can a good tone be produced on the descant recorder?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. familiarise with the descant recorder to identify its parts,
2. brainstorm on ways of caring for a descant recorder and its importance,
3. practise the techniques of playing a descant recorder,
4. use digital devices responsibly to search and watch recordings/ watch live demonstrations on

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Descant Recorder together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The learner uses digital devices to search and watch how to play notes on the descant recorder.

• Learning to learn: The learner searches for and acquires skills of how to play new notes on the descant recorder.

Values:
• Respect: The learner listens to and accommodates peers’ views during discussions.

• Responsibility: The learner takes care of the descant recorder during and after use.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Communicable diseases: The learner prevents the spread of communicable diseases by observing hygiene measures in the

use of the descant recorder.

• Social cohesion: The learner plays the descant recorder with peers in a group.

Link to other learning areas:

Agriculture: The learner applies the concepts and knowledge learnt on prevention of communicable diseases in the use of the

descant recorder.
